rounds.text: The company suffers from a severe and long-term secular contraction in its core business, demonstrated by a compounded sales growth rate of -22% over 10 years and -19% over 5 years [E14, E15]. This top-line destruction is further underscored by a severe quarterly shock, with screen data highlighting a year-on-year sales collapse of 67% [E62]. Despite any temporary profit metrics, the underlying operational reality is one of retreating scale that makes the current valuation difficult to justify. The stock demands an aggressive valuation premium that is entirely disconnected from its peers and fundamentals, trading at a P/E of 40.6x according to filed statements and 35.28x via key ratios, which towers over the sector benchmark of 19x [E1, E6]. Investors receive no income compensation for taking on this multiple risk, as the dividend yield sits firmly at 0.00% [E4]. Compounding these concerns, earnings growth is actively decelerating, and the stock languishes near the absolute bottom of its annual spectrum at just 6% of the way up its 52-week range [E5, E63]. Conceded: [E2, E7, E8, E16, E52, E59, E69].

Conceded: [E14, E15, E62]. While long-term sales figures have contracted historically [E14, E15], the company is exhibiting a dramatic operational inflection with trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth surging by a massive 197% [E16], completely overshadowing the sector median sales growth of 10.3% [E69]. The bear points to an elevated P/E ratio [E1, E6], but completely ignores the deeply discounted asset backing where the price-to-book ratio sits at an exceptional 0.44x on filed statements and 0.37x against a sector benchmark of 1.19x [E2, E7]. Furthermore, the company's asset utilization significantly outpaces the industry, delivering a return on assets of 0.83% compared to a sector benchmark of just 0.2% [E8]. Conceded: [E4, E5, E63]. Profit growth is actively exceeding 1-year price growth by 215% and satisfying positive screen criteria for year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% [E52, E59], demonstrating that the business is starting to outperform expectations despite languishing near the bottom of its 52-week range [E5].

Conceded: [E16]. While trailing twelve-month sales surged by 197% [E16], this volatile spike does not erase a structural decay characterized by a 10-year compounded sales contraction of -22% [E14], a 5-year contraction of -19% [E15], and a severe year-over-year sales collapse of -67% [E62]. The bull leans heavily on a low price-to-book ratio of 0.37x to 0.44x [E2, E7] and a superior return on assets of 0.83% [E8], but these asset metrics offer cold comfort when earnings growth is actively decelerating [E63] and the company pays a dividend yield of exactly 0.00% [E4]. Furthermore, the claim of an asset bargain is undermined by a demanding trailing P/E of 40.6x [E1] and an inflated 35.28x P/E relative to a sector benchmark of just 19x [E6]. Finally, trading near the very bottom of its 52-week range at a mere 6% of its span [E5] reflects persistent market skepticism toward this micro-cap market capitalization of ₹ 8.52 Cr [E3], completely overriding any short-term profit screen reasons [E59].
